focal_point: A pest photograph fills the left; a yellow offer panel with one code-like figure is the right-hand punch. The photo is larger, the panel is louder.
eye_path: Z from the creature to the panel to the phone at the foot of the panel.
grid: Vertical split, photo bleed, solid panel. A detail photo shows the same piece closer.
scale_ratios: The offer figure is large inside the panel and close to the headline size, not a clean 1.6×.
type_choices: One grotesque family, heavy panel type, about four sizes.
photo_art_direction: Tight creature crop, high detail, slightly sensational. Gaze is the subject staring out. Effective and a bit tabloid.
offer_placement: Right panel isolates one seasonal deal and a code. It works, and the code is a second step.
trust_and_cta: Phone at the bottom of the panel. A URL. Two responses.
